reason: A read-only visualization plugin that analyzes historical and live session logs to present skill invocation counts, timelines, session usage, and deleted-skill status through a statistics API and web dashboard.

summaries.zh: 只读统计技能调用次数、会话使用情况和调用时间，并通过 API 与网页面板提供趋势和明细视图。
summaries.en: A read-only plugin that tracks skill invocation counts, session usage, and call times, presenting trends and details through an API and web dashboard.

capabilities: Reads persisted session logs to count skill tool invocations
Subscribes to live tool-call events for incremental statistics
Provides read-only statistics through an HTTP API and web interface
Maintains an incremental local cache based on log file size and modification time
Scans workspace and global skill roots to mark deleted skills
